label: A nature has a double esse, one in singulars and another in the soul; the ratio of species belongs…
paraphrase: A nature has a double esse, one in singulars and another in the soul; the ratio of species belongs to it according to the esse it has in the intellect.
note: Source reading behind the owner's orientation that abstracta have being at most in the intellect (#1103). It is no premise of any argument and adds no condition to the adopted abstract sense, which is simply the lack of esse in re.
